title: A night backdrop with controls you can follow
description: Choose the sound, the volume and the duration in advance; keep those settings for the whole session.

blocks.text: A person picks a backdrop to make outside sounds less noticeable. In the review the person adjusts the volume themselves; that does not confirm a need for turning it up automatically during the night.

quote.text: I am a light sleeper and live on a very busy road. I use this app to block traffic noise. The pink noise is perfect. And, when my husband starts to snore, I turn it up a little louder and fall right back to sleep!

blocks.text: Show the settings before the start, save the mix and make the end of the timer easy to follow. Playback has to continue when the screen locks, in a supported mode.

What has to be tested is the whole session and the seams of a repeating recording. Reacting to the microphone is worth studying separately: a volume that changes on its own can wreck a sound someone is used to.
